summary: Preprint Table S1 named 880 hypothalamic genes selected at raw P < 0.05. Of the 788 with registered results, 642 met the same cutoff and 146 did not. All 16 Table S3 genes agreed in direction, below the 30-pair concordance minimum. The proposal passed validation and the comparison reproduced offline. [Author supplements](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.03.30.486358v1.supplementary-material)
openIssues: The full hypothalamic DESeq2 table remains unavailable. Gene-level author effect magnitudes, exact P values and FDR remain unassessed.
GEO file numbering corroborates all four notebook exclusions. Exact sample identity still requires the original count-matrix column key.
The Table S1 hypothalamic GO contributors include 111 matched genes beyond the explicit DEG lists. The authors’ enrichment input is needed to reconcile that difference.
The final Wiley workbooks could not be retrieved for a byte comparison with the preprint copies.
